key_findings: Mirtazapine (10 and 30 mg/kg/day) improved locomotor recovery and attenuated mechanical, thermal and cold allodynia after SCI in rats.
It reduced TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, IL-18, iNOS, NLRP3 and TRPV1 and raised IL-4, IL-10 and 5-HT2A receptor.
